raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Low-Impact Strength Return to Skiing"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Low-impact knee-friendly strength progression for return to skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Knee Tunneling" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation Upper/Lower acclimation":
        warmup:
          bike 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Goblet squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell bench press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Seated row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring sweep 5 minutes
      DAY Thursday training 40m "Knee-friendly Lower + Mobility":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg press (low depth) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Hip thrust (glute bridge) 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Split squat (supported) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Cable column T-bar row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad / hip flexor stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Stability & Load Tolerance":
        warmup:
          bike 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Trap bar deadlift (light) 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell incline press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute activation circuit 5 minutes
      DAY Thursday training 40m "Lower Body Maintenance":
        warmup:
          row 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg extension (controlled) 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Romanian deadlift (light) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Seated calf raise 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Face pull 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip mobility sequence 5 minutes
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progressive Load":
        warmup:
          bike 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Front squat (modified depth) 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell bench press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Seated row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring sweep 5 minutes
      DAY Thursday training 40m "Mobility & Control":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Hip thrust 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Split squat (assisted) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Cable external rotation 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Farmer carry 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          knee-friendly stretch sequence 5 minutes
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Taper & Prepare":
        warmup:
          bike 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg press (moderate depth) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell bench press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip hinge softness circuit 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2: Strength Acceleration (4 weeks)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Strength Build A":
        warmup:
          bike 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Back squat (tempo) 3x5..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Barbell bench press 3x5..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Bent-over row 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip flexor / T-spine mobility 5 minutes
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Lower Load Control":
        warmup:
          row 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift (moderate) 3x5..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Bulgarian split squat (DB) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Leg curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Face pull 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quads/hamstrings stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Strength Build B":
        warmup:
          bike 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Front squat (paused) 3x5..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Dumbbell incline press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated cable row 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          ankle & tibialis raise circuit 5 minutes
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Stability & Control":
        warmup:
          erg 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Hip thrust 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Goblet squat (to  hip height) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Band-resisted lateral walk 3x20 steps per side
          Farmer carry 3x40s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip/ankle mobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Unload & Technique":
        warmup:
          bike 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Step-up (controlled) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          push-up (knee or incline) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Seated row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          dynamic knee-friendly stretches 5 minutes
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Grip & Upper":
        warmup:
          row 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Lat pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell shoulder press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Chest-supported row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic spine mobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Ski-Specific Prep A":
        warmup:
          bike 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg press (variable depth) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell flat bench 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Seated row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip/core stability 5 minutes
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Mobility & Light Ply Control":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Hip thrust 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Split squat (assisted) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Band-resisted leg curl 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Farmer carry 3x40s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          knee-friendly mobility sequence 5 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength Density A":
        warmup:
          bike 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Back squat (tempo) 4x4..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Barbell bench press 4x4..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Bent-over row 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip hinge pattern drill 5 minutes
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Single-Leg Focus":
        warmup:
          row 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Bulgarian split squat 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Romanian deadlift (light) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Hip abduction/adduction 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Farmer carry 3x40s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          ankle mobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength Density B":
        warmup:
          bike 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Front squat (paused) 4x4..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Dumbbell incline bench 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated cable row 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobility 5 minutes
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Slope Preparation":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Hip thrust 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Step-up (moderate height) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Band-resisted leg curl 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Farmer carry 3x50s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          knee-friendly stretches 5 minutes
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Pre-Ski Peak Strength":
        warmup:
          bike 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Back squat (depth at safe range) 4x4..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Barbell bench press 4x4..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Pendlay row 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip/core stability 5 minutes
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Activation & Technique":
        warmup:
          row 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Romanian deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Split squat (bodyweight to light load) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Band-resisted leg extension 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Farmer carry 3x50s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          dynamic knee-friendly cooldown 5 minutes
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Taper for Ski Readiness":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Front squat (comfortable depth) 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell bench press 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Seated row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full lower+upper cooldown 5 minutes
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Final Prep & Ski Return Readiness":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg press (shallow depth) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Push-up (incline if needed) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full-body mobility 5 minutes

```
